messages:
maya: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: hiring & org moves. Dropping answers + next steps.

devon: Can we get the concrete headcount target for this quarter?

maya: Leadership target: 12-18 net hires this quarter. Priority split: runtime (~8), platform/console (~4), CS/solutions (~3). Final numbers after finance review next Tue.

sara: Will promotions or comp cycles be delayed if teams shift?

maya: No company-wide comp freeze. Promotions proceed on schedule. Managers will map levels for people who move within 10 business days; HR will run Q&A.

linh: For runtime hires, are we hiring FTEs or contractors?

devon: Core infra/runtime = FTE. Short-term gaps may use contractors for tooling/backfills.

carlos: If my project is deprioritized, can I interview internally without leaving payroll?

maya: Yes. Internal mobility encouraged. You remain on payroll while interviewing. Managers should post internal reqs for a 5-business-day window where possible.

hr-bot: Reminder: submit reqs into Greenhouse by EOD Friday for this approval cycle.

maya: We'll publish a weekly headcount snapshot in #finance and post a manager level-mapping guide by Monday. If you have team-specific questions DM your manager and cc recruiting. Thanks everyone.
